basics.name: Damien Dormal
basics.label: Staff Software Engineer
basics.summary: Staff Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience building and scaling distributed systems. Product-minded technical leader who bridges engineering, product, and business stakeholders. Proven track record as both IC and Engineering Manager. Proficient with AI-augmented engineering workflows. Deep expertise in card issuing platforms, IDV/KYC, and bank/network integrations powering millions of customers for Cash App and Square.

work.name: Cash App / Block
work.summary: Financial Platform — Issuing | IC → EM → IC (5 years)
highlights: Led the accounts stream for Block's Visa DPS integration — designed issuer-agnostic APIs to avoid tight coupling with Marqeta
Coordinated 4+ teams to deliver Bancorp compliance reporting (Card, KYC, transactions and balances), securing bank approval and unblocking the DPS launch
Architected the program construct to manage Block's growing card issuing portfolio across multiple issuer processors and sponsoring banks
Rebuilt denylisting orchestration on Temporal, replacing 3 legacy APIs with a reliable workflow supporting customer appeals and detailed reporting to partner banks
Led a task force to resolve data consistency issues in the Marqeta integration, fixing incorrect account states for ~50K customers and stabilizing the Sutton BIN sponsor relationship
Founded and grew the New Markets team (3–5 engineers) owning account management and card program infrastructure; authored the strategic roadmap and business case for expansion
Enabled the launch of Cash Teen (sponsored accounts) for Cash App Card, driving KYC pipeline changes and contributing to 5M+ new monthly active users

work.name: Envato
highlights: Designed and developed a new API to distribute content across the organisation, enabling downstream teams to consume assets programmatically
Led the decomposition of a monolith application into services, extracting key functionalities into independently deployable microservices
Led infrastructure and DevOps improvements within the group, organising and facilitating monthly infrastructure catchups

work.name: Locomote
highlights: Developed the booking tool (Node.js) and travel management platform (Rails) serving enterprise customers
Transformed the booking tool to support multiple booking APIs, enabling the platform to aggregate travel suppliers
Supported engineers and hired new staff, improving developer engagement through cross-team meetings

work.name: Moko Social Media
highlights: Built the API for Speakiesy, an intramural social app launched to 100+ college campuses (Rails)
Introduced new DevOps strategy using Docker and AWS ECS, modernizing the deployment pipeline
